summary: Optimize admin Directory performance by changing leader photo display to filename-only with click-to-open full image in a modal overlay (no lazy loading for now).
architectural_notes: Admin Directory should avoid rendering/loading leader images inline; render filename text and fetch/display full image only on click via modal overlay.
known_issues: Live app becomes unresponsive on admin login when opening Admin Directory, likely due to inefficient leader photo loading/rendering.

existing_features.title: Update the Admin Directory page so that every leader/representative photo is displayed as text (the image file name or stored photoPath string) instead of rendering any image thumbnail in the list/table view.
When an admin clicks the displayed photo filename/text for a leader/representative in Admin Directory, open a modal/window overlay popup that shows the full-size photo.

Ensure Admin Directory does not perform lazy-loading behavior for representative photos as part of this change (i.e., do not add intersection-observer-based image lazy-loading); only fetch/resolve the image URL when the modal is opened.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin Directory: replace leader photo thumbnails with image filename text; clicking filename opens full photo in modal overlay (no lazy loading).

projectName: Admin Directory: render leader photo as filename with click-to-open modal (no lazy loading)
